verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management platform. Reviewing AI-agent code diffs, leaving line-level code comments from a mobile app and having a coding agent iterate belongs to code hosts and coding agents, so this axis does not apply to Asana. The evidence does not show Asana shipping it: the GitHub integration only syncs pull request status to tasks, and the AI Teammates handle coordination work rather than code changes.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
